def _gen_aliased_field(self, state: GenState, crown: InpFieldCrown, field: InputField):
        parent = state.parent
        keys = (state.path[-1], *crown.aliases)
        key_var = f"alias_key_{field.id}"
        present_var = f"alias_present_{field.id}"
        with state.builder(f"if not isinstance({parent.v_data}, CollectionsMapping):"):
            self._gen_raise_bad_type_error(state, f"TypeLoadError(CollectionsMapping, {parent.v_data})", namer=parent)
        state.type_checked_type_paths.add(state.parent_path)
        state.builder += f"{present_var} = [key for key in {keys!r} if key in {parent.v_data}]"
        with state.builder(f"if len({present_var}) > 1:"):
            state.builder += parent.emit_error(f"ExtraFieldsLoadError(set({present_var}), {parent.v_data})")
        with state.builder(f"if not {present_var}:"):
            if field.is_required:
                error = f"NoRequiredFieldsLoadError({{{keys[0]!r}}}, {parent.v_data})"
                state.builder += parent.emit_error(error)
            elif not self._is_packed_field(field):
                state.builder += f"{state.v_field(field)} = {self._get_default_clause_expr(state, field)}"
            else:
                state.builder += "pass"
        with state.builder("else:"):
            state.builder += f"{key_var} = {present_var}[0]"
            assign_to = (f"packed_fields[{self._field_id_to_param[field.id].name!r}]"
                         if self._is_packed_field(field) else state.v_field(field))
            loader = state.v_field_loader(field.id)
            expression = f"{parent.v_data}[{key_var}]"
            if self._field_loaders[field.id] != as_is_stub:
                expression = f"{loader}({expression})"
            if self._debug_trail in (DebugTrail.FIRST, DebugTrail.ALL):
                with state.builder("try:"):
                    state.builder += f"{assign_to} = {expression}"
                with state.builder("except Exception as e:"):
                    trail_expr = f"append_trail(e, {key_var})"
                    if parent.path:
                        trail_expr = f"extend_trail({trail_expr}, {parent.path!r})"
                    if self._debug_trail == DebugTrail.ALL:
                        state.builder += f"errors.append({trail_expr})"
                    else:
                        state.builder += f"raise {trail_expr}"
            else:
                state.builder += f"{assign_to} = {expression}"
